name: Conifer Boutique Hotel
location: Trang Tien Ward, Hoan Kiem District
highlighted_review:
Nestled on a quieter street just a short walk from Hanoi's vibrant Old Quarter, the Conifer Hotel offers a perfect blend of peaceful retreat and urban convenience. It’s a great choice for travelers who want to be close to the action but still be able to retreat to a calm and comfortable space at the end of the day.

The location is arguably the hotel's biggest strength. Just minutes away from iconic landmarks like the Hanoi Opera House and Hoan Kiem Lake, you are perfectly positioned to explore the city's main attractions on foot. Despite being so central, the hotel is tucked away enough to provide a peaceful and quiet environment, away from the constant buzz of the city streets.

Upon arrival, guests are consistently impressed by the warmth and hospitality of the staff. Many reviews highlight the team's exceptional friendliness and willingness to go above and beyond, whether it's helping with tour bookings, arranging transportation, or simply offering a warm greeting. This high level of service makes the stay feel personal and welcoming.

The rooms themselves are clean, well-appointed, and comfortable, offering all the necessary amenities for a pleasant stay. While some rooms may be a bit smaller, they are efficiently designed and many feature lovely balconies with city views. The hotel also offers a delicious breakfast with a variety of options, including both Vietnamese and Western dishes, which many guests rave about.

Overall, the Conifer Hotel stands out as a charming and excellent value boutique option in Hanoi. It delivers a high-quality experience through its prime location, impeccable service, and comfortable accommodations. It's an ideal choice for tourists seeking a well-rounded and hospitable base for their adventures in Vietnam’s capital.

name: Sogo Hotel Saigon
highlighted_review: As a person who often travels for work and leisure, I highly appreciate Sogo Hotel for the following reasons (you can refer to it): The hotel receptionist is very enthusiastic, takes care of guests attentively and always supports to resolve guests' requests WITH JOY!!! (I arrived 6 hours early and checked out 1 hour late, the female receptionist - I think the hotel only has 2 receptionists - was very enthusiastic in supporting. Not to mention I booked an extra night because I had to stay overnight. She also helped me change rooms very thoughtfully. Because the room I was staying in was already booked by the next guest. However, she helped me move the room from the 2nd floor to the 3rd floor so that I could move my luggage more easily. I was very satisfied with the receptionist's thoughtfulness even though she did not proactively tell the guest that she moved the room from the 2nd floor to the 3rd floor because of that. The receptionist on the evening shift was also very okay, helpfull and very respectful of the guest) In terms of personality, I rate 10 points! The hotel room is also very clean (I noticed the housekeeping lady cleaning the other rooms, she cleaned very neatly. Not to mention she is also very enthusiastic and friendly!), the room space is airy and the air conditioner is very cool, even though the hotel has been in operation for quite a long time, I am satisfied with the way the hotel is maintained and taken care of to bring a good experience to guests. Besides, although this hotel is located in the central area of District 1, the space is very quiet and not noisy, the soundproofing between rooms is also very good. Regarding transportation, major tourist attractions, large shopping centers and hospitals are all within a radius of 1-2km and very easy to get to; you can walk to save money, or if the sun is hot, take a taxi, it will only cost 20-30k. The hotel is also very close to the offices of major bus companies in SG, very convenient to transfer from the bus station to the hotel and vice versa; very convenient!!! Finally, if you are looking for a place that is cost-effective and has adequate amenities, clean rooms, and easy access to locations in District 1 and even other districts of Ho Chi Minh City, I highly recommend this hotel ✨✨✨✨✨

name: 22Land Hotel Saigon
highlighted_review:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

22Land Hotel Saigon is my all-time favourite hotel whenever I visit Ho Chi Minh City. From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond to make me feel welcome. The check-in process was smooth and efficient, and every team member I interacted with was friendly, attentive, and genuinely caring.

The room was spotless, modern, and very comfortable, with all the amenities I needed for a relaxing stay. The bed was especially cozy, and I appreciated the thoughtful touches that made it feel like a home away from home.

A special thank you to the hotel staff for kindly accommodating my early morning check-in and for the thoughtful gesture of turning on the air-conditioning in advance so the room was cool and refreshing when I arrived. These small but meaningful details truly set the experience apart.

The location is excellent—conveniently close to many attractions, restaurants, and shopping areas, yet still peaceful enough to enjoy a good night’s rest. The breakfast selection was also impressive, with fresh and delicious options to start the day right.

What truly stood out to me was the exceptional service. The staff were always ready to help with a smile, whether it was arranging transportation, giving local recommendations, or simply making sure I had everything I needed. Their warmth and professionalism made my stay memorable.

I highly recommend 22Land Hotel Saigon to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City. I’ll definitely return on my next trip!

highlighted_review: I had a great experience at Alba. I learned about Alba during the pandemic and watched reviews on youtube, thinking I definitely had to come here to experience it. Maybe this time I was "lucky" because the resort was empty because the vacation ended and it was during the week, so the space was even quieter and the services were quick. I was most impressed with the 8-step Onsen bath service, I liked step number 8 the most, the outdoor bath :)) I have experienced onsen in Japan, in Quang Ninh, but Alba left a pretty good impression with its decor, cleanliness, massage care service... I think when you come to Hue, you should stay in the city for 1 day and stay at Alba for 2-3 days to rest and escape the noise and dust. You shouldn't expect too much from the resort... Alba is decorated with many trees, close to nature and with such a room rate, it is very reasonable. Thank you Alba and I wish you will have many guests to take better care of the health of Vietnamese people. To emphasize again: ALBA is a resort, not for virtual life or sparkling beauty.

We stayed at Kim Hoa Resort in Phu Quoc for 6 days and 5 nights. Overall, it was a pretty nice experience. The location is great—the beach is just in front of the hotel, so it’s very easy to access. The resort also has pools, which is a plus. Surprisingly, even though it was a holiday, the place wasn’t crowded, which made it more relaxing.

The only downside during our stay was the weather—it rained almost the whole time, so we couldn’t really enjoy the beach as much as we wanted. But of course, that’s not the hotel’s fault.

The staff were okay and accommodating, and the breakfast was decent. Most days it was a buffet, but on one day we had to order instead of buffet—still fine and satisfying.

All in all, a comfortable and peaceful stay. Would recommend if you want a beachfront resort with a calm atmosphere.

name: Hoi An Heart Lodge
highlighted_review: This is my first time in Hoi An and I'm very lucky to have found a place to stay that I really like! First, the location of the Lodge: it's easy to find and very close to the old town as well as the famous specialty dining areas of Hoi An. I can walk or ride a bike if I want to chill with the city's atmosphere. I was able to borrow a free bike from the Lodge. If you want to go far and longer, you can rent a motorbike from the Lodge, which is both convenient and cheaper than outside! About the room: I checked in 3 hours earlier than scheduled, but the owner still supported me without charging any extra fees. (depending on the number of guests, if the room is empty, the owner is always ready to support). The room I received was very new, beautiful and clean. A lot of investment was made in the decor, with many beautiful corners for selfies together. The mattress was extremely soft and didn't cause back pain. The room was equipped with an air conditioner and a water fan, which was quite good and convenient for guests' needs. I'm allergic to air conditioning, so I really like the water fan at the Lodge ^^. Toilet: this is also one of the very important points that I care about and Lodge did not disappoint me. The lodge toilet is very clean, the interior is very classy, the room is cheap but the bathroom interior is the same as the big resorts. Management: the owner is extremely cute, friendly, hospitable and very polite. He really cares about the feelings of the customers (when I go up and down the room or meet his children, they are always greeted very politely, and even wish me good night! Very lovely ^^). The owner also helped me book a car to the airport at a cheaper price than the taxi or grab price I booked myself + helped me take my suitcase to the car because I was afraid I would miss my flight. I only stayed for 1 day but still received very good service. If I have the opportunity to return to Hoi An, I will definitely return to Hoi An Heart Lodge. To clarify, I am a customer, I write a lot because I like it, I was not asked or booked to review anything ^^, and I highly recommend it to anyone who intends to rent a room when traveling to Hoi An!
